attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file CT state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "CT Filing Requirement Determination Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in CT (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code "CT" strcasecmp 0 eq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code "CT" strcasecmp 0 eq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - CT filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "CT filing required: Physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT Form CT-1120, CT General Statutes § 12-214" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - CT filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "CT filing required: Economic nexus (post-Wayfair)" job.audit_trail swap addto "CT threshold: $500,000 in gross receipts (no transaction count requirement)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Higher than typical $100,000 threshold - CT business-friendly approach" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT DRS Economic Nexus Guidance" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no CT filing required
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No CT nexus - no filing requirement" job.audit_trail swap addto "Any estimated payments would be refunded" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate CT state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income per CT Form CT-1120 Schedules I and J.

initial_action.action_postfix: "CT Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CT state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /additions xdef
additions /apportionment.state_additions xdef
0.0 /subtractions xdef
subtractions /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"CT state-specific income adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto "Additions to federal taxable income:" job.audit_trail swap addto " - Interest on U.S. government obligations (federally tax-exempt, CT taxable)" job.audit_trail swap addto " - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction (CT addback)" job.audit_trail swap addto " - Bonus depreciation (CT decouples from federal bonus depreciation)" job.audit_trail swap addto " - Other items per CT Form CT-1120 Schedule I" job.audit_trail swap addto "Subtractions from federal taxable income:" job.audit_trail swap addto " - Interest on CT state and municipal bonds" job.audit_trail swap addto " - CT net operating loss deduction" job.audit_trail swap addto " - Dividend deduction for certain subsidiary corporations" job.audit_trail swap addto " - Other items per CT Form CT-1120 Schedule J" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT Form CT-1120 Instructions (Schedules I and J)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT General Statutes § 12-217 (Computation of tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT DRS Special Notice 2018(5) - Federal Tax Reform" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"No CT nexus - no state adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate CT state corporate income tax. Applies CT 7.5% flat tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income per CT General Statutes § 12-214.

initial_action.action_postfix: "CT State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CT tax using 7.5% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix:
apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"CT state corporate income tax calculation:" job.audit_trail swap addto "1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28]" job.audit_trail swap addto "2. Apportioned to CT: × [Single-sales apportionment %]" job.audit_trail swap addto "3. State additions: + [Additions per Schedule I]" job.audit_trail swap addto "4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions per Schedule J]" job.audit_trail swap addto "5. CT taxable income: = " apportionment.state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "6. CT tax rate: × 7.5%" job.audit_trail swap addto "7. CT income tax: = " apportionment.state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "8. CT credits: - [Credits]" job.audit_trail swap addto "9. CT tax liability: = $" apportionment.state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Connecticut uses a flat 7.5% tax rate on all corporate income" job.audit_trail swap addto "This rate has been stable since 2018" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT Form CT-1120 Corporation Business Tax Return" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT General Statutes § 12-214 (Tax imposed - 7.5% rate)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT DRS Form CT-1120 Instructions" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No CT nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No CT nexus - no tax liability" job.audit_trail swap addto "Any estimated payments are refunded" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No CT taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No CT taxable income - no tax liability" job.audit_trail swap addto "CT NOL rules may apply (can carry forward losses to future years)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: CT General Statutes § 12-217(a)(2) (NOL carryforward)" job.audit_trail swap addto
